other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen
Applicant must be a permanent resident of Maharashtra for at least 15 years
Applicant must be 65 years or older
Applicant’s family must be listed as Below Poverty Line (BPL) or have an annual family income less than or equal to ₹21,000
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹600 per beneficiary (₹200 from the Indira Gandhi Old Age Pension Scheme for BPL families and ₹400 from the Shravanbal State Pension Scheme, or full ₹600 from the State scheme for non‑BPL families with income ≤₹21,000).
